text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I head to the infirmary to pay

<chrname> a visit to since
she
recently got injured... only to see a
familiar figure
already standing by her
bedside.

text_block_list.name: Sasami Anshinzawa
text_block_list.text:
Here I go! A little poke, and your injury
will be as
good as healed!

text_block_list.name: Sasami Anshinzawa
text_block_list.text:
Treating a patient, duh! This poor
Umamusume
needs medical attention!
choice_data_list_en: What are you planning to do!?

text_block_list.name: Sasami Anshinzawa
text_block_list.text:
And if not an acupuncturist to give her a
good
poke, then who?!

text_block_list.name: Sasami Anshinzawa
text_block_list.text:
I've even looked up chakra points that
help treat
injuries! You have to give me
a chance! Please!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Even though I want to do everything I
can for
<chrname>'s benefit,
it doesn't feel
safe leaving her in the
hands of Sasami
Anshinzawa.

text_block_list.name: Sasami Anshinzawa
text_block_list.text:
I think you might be misunderstanding
my
intentions. I'm not treating
Umamusume just for
acupuncture's sake.

text_block_list.name: Sasami Anshinzawa
text_block_list.text:
It's the other way around! I'm doing
acupuncture
for all Umamusume kind's
sake!

text_block_list.name: Sasami Anshinzawa
text_block_list.text:
And I'd be elated if their futures
involved more
needles...
choice_data_list: そこまでウマ娘のことを……！
choice_data_list_en: To care that much about Umamusume...!

text_block_list.name: Sasami Anshinzawa
text_block_list.text:
Leave the rest to me. Sorry, I can't have
people
milling about while I'm providing
treatment, so
off you go!

text_block_list.name: Sasami Anshinzawa
text_block_list.text:
And while I'm at it, I'll take this
opportunity to try
a few things! ☆

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Th-thump! Kablam! Zrrrt! Whirrr!

text_block_list.name: Sasami Anshinzawa
text_block_list.text:
I-it's a miracle! She's in even better
shape than
before she got injured... How
can this be?!

text_block_list.name: Sasami Anshinzawa
text_block_list.text:
It sure was nerve-wracking when I poked
the
wrong chakra, but wow! I'm a
genius! ☆

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Just as Sasami proclaimed,

<chrname> has made a
complete
recovery and is now stronger
than ever!

text_block_list.name: Sasami Anshinzawa
text_block_list.text:
It was a great success! I guess info on
Umatter can
be pretty trustworthy after
all...

text_block_list.name: Sasami Anshinzawa
text_block_list.text:
Oh, by the way, I took the liberty of
activating a
few extra chakra that'll
boost her strength! ☆

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Just as Sasami proclaimed,

<chrname> has recovered
from her
injury and grown stronger!

text_block_list.name: Sasami Anshinzawa
text_block_list.text:
Hmm... Something doesn't feel quite
right... It's
almost like the treatment's
not working or
something...

text_block_list.name: Sasami Anshinzawa
text_block_list.text:
Well, everyone has off days! Anyways,
I'll be
going! The rest is up to you! ☆

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
She might not have healed from her
injuries, but
I'm just glad that
<chrname> is safe
and sound.
